subject: Vendor change — request for onward transfer permission & DPIA evidence
messages:
From: Alexa Santos <alexa.santos@globocloud.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: elena.novikova@globocloud.com
Date: 2026-03-21T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Notice: planned onward transfer for EU ingress routing

Hi Markus,

Quick heads-up from the Ops team: starting April 5 we plan to route a subset of EU customer ingestion (metadata and non-content telemetry used for routing/observability) through a third-party partner, EdgeRoute Ltd., to improve regional failover and reduce latency. EdgeRoute will process only hashed connection metadata, load metrics, and ephemeral routing logs — no PII content payloads.

We understand this counts as an onward transfer under our DPA. Attached is our draft DPIA and a dataflow matrix summarizing what will be shared, retention windows, and data locations. We can also provide the signed SCCs and an updated subprocessor statement; Elena (cc) is our compliance lead and attached the DPIA PDF.

Would Redwood be able to review and provide written permission (email reply or DocuSign approval) by March 28? If you need additional evidence (ISO27001 certificate, pen test report), we can provide redacted copies under an NDA.

Attachments: Globocloud-DPIA-20260301.pdf (stub), dataflow_matrix_v2.xlsx (stub)

Thanks,
Alexa Santos
Head of Operations — Globocloud
alexa.santos@globocloud.com
+44 20 5555 1212

--

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexa Santos <alexa.santos@globocloud.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-21T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: planned onward transfer for EU ingress routing

Alexa — thanks for the notification and the DPIA stub. We appreciate the level of detail. A couple quick clarifying questions before we can grant permission:

- Confirm the exact categories of data shared with EdgeRoute (you say hashed metadata & ephemeral logs). Will any request/response content or embeddings ever be routed?
- Retention: what are the default retention periods for the routing logs? We prefer <=30 days unless needed for incident response.
- Subprocessing chain: will EdgeRoute further engage any subprocessor(s)? If so, who are they and where are they located?
- SCCs / transfer legal: please attach the executed SCCs between Globocloud and EdgeRoute and confirm that transfers to non-EEA countries rely on appropriate safeguards.
- Controls: can you supply ISO27001, SOC 2 Type II summaries, and the pen test summary redacted?

For our internal compliance approval, please also provide: the DPIA (PDF), the dataflow matrix (spreadsheet), and a short one-page risk mitigation note stating how you will limit retention and isolate processing to routing functions. If you can upload everything to the Drive link or attach here, that speeds review.

We aim to respond formally to FinTrust by March 29. Can you confirm whether you need our signed permission via DocuSign or an email approval is sufficient? If DocuSign, please send the link and we will route to procurement/legal.

Thanks — Mark
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Ops (acting) — Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwoodinference.com

>

From: Elena Novikova <elena.novikova@globocloud.com>
To: markus.klein@redwoodinference.com
Cc: alexa.santos@globocloud.com
Date: 2026-03-21T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: planned onward transfer for EU ingress routing — DPIA and evidence attached

Hi Markus — following up with the materials you requested. Apologies for the delay this morning; attaching the DPIA and the dataflow matrix we referenced. Short answers below and please see the DPIA for full detail.

- Data categories: routing metadata (IP hashed, ASN, routing headers), ephemeral load metrics, error/timing telemetry. No request/response content or embeddings will be shared with EdgeRoute.
- Retention: default 14 days for routing logs, 90 days for aggregated metrics. We can limit routing log retention to 30 days for FinTrust by configuration flag.
- Subprocessing chain: EdgeRoute does not presently engage further subprocessors for this function. If that changes we'll notify you and provide onward transfer details.
- SCCs/Legal: executing SCCs between Globocloud and EdgeRoute are attached (sccs-signed.pdf). Transfers outside EEA rely on SCCs and encryption-in-transit; see section 4.2 of the DPIA.
- Controls: ISO27001 certificate (summary enclosed in DPIA appendix) and a redacted pen test executive summary are in the Drive folder.

Attachments (stubs): Globocloud-DPIA-20260301.pdf, dataflow_matrix_v2.xlsx, sccs-signed.pdf
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B7Example/globocloud-dpia
DocuSign permission form (optional): https://docusign.com/rooms/ABC123-onward-transfer

We can set the retention to 30 days for FinTrust and flag any change-of-subprocessor notifications. Please confirm if an email approval is sufficient; otherwise we can push a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Regards,
Elena Novikova
Senior Compliance Counsel — Globocloud
elena.novikova@globocloud.com

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: elena.novikova@globocloud.com, alexa.santos@globocloud.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-03-21T14:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Notice: planned onward transfer for EU ingress routing — DPIA and evidence attached

Elena / Alexa — thanks for the fast turnaround and for the attachments. Redwood is OK to approve the onward transfer to EdgeRoute Ltd for the EU routing use case, subject to the following conditions:

1) Retention for routing logs limited to 30 days for FinTrust Bank by configuration flag (confirm when applied).
2) Executed SCCs in place (we have received sccs-signed.pdf) and encryption-in-transit confirmed in the DPIA section referenced.
3) Prior notice for any further downward subcontracting (EdgeRoute engages additional subprocessors) with at least 14 days to review.
4) Globocloud to provide a redacted pen test executive summary within 7 business days for our records.

If you confirm the retention change and send either an email confirmation or the DocuSign approval link, we'll notify FinTrust and update our vendor roster.

Approved-by: Markus Klein (email approval accepted per internal policy)

Thanks,
Markus Klein
